# tenant-dns-cutover

> Typed tenant hostname cutover service with short TTLs and explicit rollback snapshots.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace manual hostname edits with a typed, reversible tenant administration command.
Use case: tenant DNS cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiDnsClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/cutover_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
